blocks.text: Mukhtalif wavelengths aur amplitudes wali lehrein jama hon to pecheeda (complex) lehrein banti hain. Dilchasp nataij tab milte hain jab aik hi wavelength ki do lehrein kisi point par aik doosre ke oopar aa jayen (overlap). Do coherent lehrein kisi jagah milti hain to kuch points par aik doosre ko mazboot (reinforce) karti hain aur kuch points par aik doosre ko khatam (cancel) kar deti hain. Is tarah jo naqsha (pattern) banta hai use interference kehte hain. Yeh samajhne ke liye hum principle of superposition (lehron ke jama hone ka usool) istemal karte hain. Do loudspeakers lein jo aik hi frequency aur wavelength ki awaz nikaal rahe hain. Figure 15.3 dikhati hai ke interference kaise banta hai. Dono loudspeakers aik hi source se jure hain, is liye in phase (qadam se qadam mila kar) lehrein chhorte hain. Loudspeakers ke samne har point par dono ki lehrein pohanchti hain. Kuch points par dono lehrein barabar amplitude ke saath in phase pohanchti hain (Fig. 15.3(a)). Superposition ke mutabiq resultant (nateeja) lehar ka amplitude aik lehar ka dugna hota hai, aur hamein zyada unchi awaz sunai deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig.15.4-a' likhti hai. Barabar amplitude ki do in-phase lehrein Fig. 15.3(a) mein dikhayi gayi hain; Fig. 15.4 ka koi hissa (a) nahi hai.

blocks.alt: Displacement (10^-4 m ki ikai mein, -4 se 4) aur waqt ke teen graph. (a) Amplitude 2 ki neeli aur sabz lehrein aik doosre ke oopar; gulabi nateeja amplitude 4. (b) Amplitude 2 ki neeli aur sabz lehrein aadhe chakkar ke farq par; nateeja waqt ke mehwar par seedhi lakeer. (c) Amplitude 1 ki neeli aur amplitude 2 ki sabz lehar hum-qadam; gulabi nateeja amplitude 3.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.3: Superposition se lehron ka jor. Barabar amplitude ki lehrein (a) constructive ya (b) destructive interference deti hain; (c) mukhtalif amplitude ki lehrein bhi constructive interference kar sakti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki (b) mein doosri lehar gulabi rang mein hai, jo baqi graphs mein nateeje (resultant) ka rang hai; asal nateeja sifar wali seedhi lakeer hai. Kitab ki (c) mein 1 aur 2 amplitude ki lehron ka nateeja taqreeban 4 tak chhapa hai, jabke jor 1 + 2 = 3 hona chahiye. Khaake mein (b) ki dono lehrein neeli aur sabz hain aur (c) ka nateeja 3 hai.
Do lehron ke interference ke liye bunyadi sharait (conditions) yeh hain:

items: Lehrein aik hi qism ki hon, yani awaz ki lehrein sirf awaz ki lehron ke saath interference karti hain.
Lehrein coherent hon, yani un ka phase difference (phase ka farq) constant rahe.
Lehrein aik hi ya taqreeban aik hi simt mein chal rahi hon.

blocks.text: Amplitudes mukhtalif hon tab bhi do lehrein interference kar sakti hain, lekin is se pattern ke roshan aur andhere (ya unchi aur dheemi awaz wale) hisson ka farq (contrast) kam ho jata hai.

Hamare ird gird kai qism ki lehrein hain, jaise nazar aane wali roshni, infrared radiations, radio waves aur awaz. Har simt se lehrein hum tak aa rahi hain. To phir hum har waqt interference patterns kyun nahi dekhte? Aur laboratory mein khaas saaman (equipment) ki zaroorat kyun parti hai?
Asal mein rozmarra zindagi mein bhi roshni ka interference nazar aata hai. Maslan dhund wali raat mein street lamps ya chaand ke gird roshni ke halqe (haloes) aap ne dekhe honge.
Kapre ke peeche se kisi tez roshni ko dekhein to roshan aur andhere patte nazar aate hain. Yeh bhi interference ke asraat hain.

Napne ke qabil interference ke liye aam taur par khaas intizam chahiye. Do loudspeakers wala tajurba sochein. Agar woh do alag signal generators se jure hon jin ki frequencies thori si mukhtalif hon, to lehrein shuru mein in phase ho sakti hain lekin jald hi out of phase ho jayengi (Fig. 15.4). Hamein pehle unchi, phir dheemi, phir unchi awaz sunai degi, aur interference pattern kamre mein idhar udhar khisakta rahega.

blocks.alt: Thori mukhtalif wavelength ki gulabi aur neeli lehar ka displacement aur waqt. Dono 0 se shuru; pehli chotiyan saath (in phase). Phir woh hat-ti jati hain, yahan tak ke dashed khari lakeer (out of phase) par neeli ki chotti gulabi ke garhe se milti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: Thori mukhtalif wavelengths ki lehrein, is liye aik doosre ke saath phase mein aati aur phase se nikalti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dono loudspeakers ko aik hi signal generator se jorne par yaqeeni hai ke un ki lehrein hamesha in phase rahengi. Hum kehte hain ke woh awaz ki lehron ke do coherent sources hain (coherent ka matlab hai saath jure rehna). Coherent sources aisi lehrein chhorte hain jin ka phase difference constant ho. Yaad rakhein: do lehron ka phase difference sirf tab constant reh sakta hai jab un ki frequencies barabar hon aur badlein nahi.

Ab laser wala tajurba sochein. Kya hum bilkul aik hi frequency (aur is liye aik hi wavelength) wale do lasers istemal kar sakte the? Figure 15.5 laser ki roshni dikhati hai. Ise bohat se alag alag bursts (roshni ke chhote jhonke) samjhein. Is ki koi zamanat nahi ke do lasers ke bursts hamesha in phase rahein.

Yeh masla aik hi laser le kar us ki roshni ko do slits se do hisson mein baantne se hal hota hai (Fig. 15.5). Dono slits roshni ke do coherent sources ban jate hain. Woh hamesha aik doosre ke saath in phase rehte hain (ya un ka phase difference constant rehta hai).

blocks.alt: Teen surkh lehron ke silsile. Oopar wale mein phase ki achanak tabdeeli (sudden change of phase) teer se dikhayi gayi hai. Beech wale silsile par double slit wali neeli slide khari hai. Teenon ko kaatne wali khari lakeer dikhati hai ke phase ki tabdeeli har aik mein aik hi jagah hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Saaf interference naqshe ke liye lehron ka coherent hona zaruri hai (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laser ki roshni chhote chhote jhonkon (bursts) mein aati hai aur har naye jhonke par phase achanak badal jata hai. Do alag lasers ke jhonke aapas mein mel nahi khate. Aik hi laser ki roshni double slit se do hisson mein bant jaye to dono hisson mein phase ki tabdeeli bilkul aik saath hoti hai, is liye un ka phase farq constant rehta hai: yehi coherent sources hain.

Agar woh coherent sources na hon to interference pattern lagatar aur itni tezi se badalta ke aankh pakar na sakti. Hamein sirf yaksan (uniform) roshni ki patti nazar aati, jis mein saaf roshan aur andhere hisse na hote. Is se pata chalta hai ke interference dekhne ke liye do coherent sources zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Do lampon ki roshni screen par pare to interference pattern kyun nahi banta?
blocks.explanation: Do lampon ki roshni coherent nahi hoti: un ka phase difference be-tarteeb aur bohat tezi se badalta hai, is liye pattern aust (average) ho kar yaksan roshni ban jata hai.

items: Interference: do coherent lehrein kuch jagah mazboot aur kuch jagah khatam hoti hain (superposition).
Sharait: aik hi qism, coherent (constant phase difference), taqreeban aik hi simt.
Mukhtalif amplitudes se bhi interference hota hai lekin contrast kam hota hai.
Coherent sources ke liye barabar aur na badalne wali frequency chahiye; aik laser ki roshni do slits se baant kar coherent sources milte hain.
